law: q = F p + (1-F)/D on the 2^m register outcomes; mirror and out-of-band bins masked after sampling; Multinomial(S, q)

f_predictor.rule: lowest leave-one-out Brier (top-1) on the 26 Sep 25 rows; ties by LOO mean |F error|

selection.window: non-overlapping 512-sample windows from 1 s into the run, zero-mean, max-abs normalised

J2_dyn_default_4k.note: default options: DD and twirling off, as the Sep 25 dynamic job ran after DD was refused

rules.R1: Spearman(pred P(top-1), 1/observed rank) >= 0.4 and one-sided permutation p < 0.05 (10000 permutations, seed 20260926)
rules.R2: Brier(top-1) of the law < Brier of the constant 0.5000 (Sep 25 rate)
rules.R4: Brier(top-1) + Brier(top-3) of the law < the same score of the noiseless limit of the law (F = 1, shot noise only), both from 20,000-draw Monte Carlo
rules.verdict: CONFIRMED if R1-R4 all pass; FALSIFIED if R1 fails, or R4 fails, or both R2 and R3 fail; PARTIAL otherwise
